customer_message.subject: Black mould in my flat at Rosenstrasse 44, landlord has not fixed it
customer_message.body: Hi, I need some advice about my flat. I'm Jamie Foster and I rent a 3-room flat at Rosenstrasse 44 in Aarau from Livit-Partner Verwaltungen AG. Since last winter there has been black mould spreading on the bedroom wall and around the bathroom window. I reported it to the landlord's office in writing a while ago, but nothing has been fixed yet. Honestly I'm really worried because my partner has been having breathing problems since the mould appeared, and the doctor thinks it could be linked to the damp air in the flat. We've cleaned the wall several times but it keeps coming back within a few weeks. Today is 25 September 2026 and I want to know what my options are, and whether my legal expenses insurance covers a lawyer to push the landlord to act. Can you tell me what documents you need from me? I can send photos of the mould and copies of the letters I sent to the landlord. Thanks a lot.
